Avoid hidden globals, ambient singletons, static caches, and order-dependent initialization.

Make data creation concise, valid by default, and capable of expressing edge states.
Allow failure, timeout, cancellation, retry, and partial-response injection at material boundaries.

Keep units cohesive enough that failures localize the cause.
Avoid nondeterministic concurrency and network dependence in lower-level tests.
Design migrations and background jobs to support dry run, checkpoint, and reconciliation.
Expose health and diagnostic signals suitable for production-safe verification.
Ensure tests can distinguish absence of work from successful completion.
Measure test setup complexity and time as design feedback.
Refactor production design when testing requires excessive private knowledge or brittle global setup.
Extract reuse only when multiple consumers share stable semantics and change drivers.
Keep reusable units cohesive and independent of consumer-specific workflow.
Define explicit inputs, outputs, errors, side effects, resource ownership, and extension points.
Use configuration for genuine variation, not to combine incompatible responsibilities.
Provide safe defaults and prevent invalid configuration combinations.
Avoid leaking one consumer's terminology, permissions, tenant context, or data into the shared contract.
Keep dependencies minimal and visible.
Version and document compatibility commitments.
Provide examples for ordinary use and guidance for unsupported use.
Test each supported context and representative integration.
Track consumers and communicate security fixes, deprecations, and breaking changes.
Avoid global utility modules without ownership or domain boundaries.
Prefer local duplication over a shared abstraction that causes coordinated change across unrelated products.
Measure whether reuse reduces total defects, effort, and inconsistency after maintenance cost.
Provide a clear path to fork or replace when shared governance no longer serves consumers.
Retire unused exports and variants.
Keep reusable security and validation functions context-aware rather than universally permissive.
Do not expose internal implementation merely to make reuse convenient.
Avoid inheritance or mixins that create hidden coupling and fragile override behavior.
Treat reuse as a product with ownership, support, documentation, and lifecycle.
Treat correctness, security, privacy, safety, accessibility, and recoverability as constraints; optimize elegance, reuse, and brevity only within those constraints.

heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Use stable event names, field definitions, units, identifiers, severity, and versioning so telemetry remains interpretable across releases.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Propagate correlation and causation context across asynchronous and distributed work without trusting caller-supplied identifiers blindly.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Make important failures distinguishable by cause, affected operation, dependency, tenant, release, and retryability.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Avoid high-cardinality, secret-bearing, personal, attacker-controlled, or unbounded telemetry fields.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Ensure diagnostic logging cannot change business behavior, exhaust critical resources, or introduce deadlocks.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Use sampling that preserves rare critical events and supports unbiased interpretation.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Make audit records tamper-resistant and semantically distinct from ordinary debug logs where accountability is required.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Provide enough state and decision context to reconstruct consequential outcomes without logging prohibited data.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Test telemetry assertions, alert predicates, dashboards, and trace propagation as part of behavior.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Make telemetry pipeline failure observable and ensure the application has deliberate degradation behavior.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Remove temporary debug logging, probes, and sensitive instrumentation before production unless explicitly approved.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Define a schema, type, allowed range, default, owner, sensitivity, environment scope, and reload behavior for every material configuration value.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Fail startup or activation safely when required configuration is absent, malformed, contradictory, stale, or insecure.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Do not let a missing flag service, configuration store, or secret silently enable risky behavior.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Test all material feature-flag combinations, transitions, targeting rules, default states, and rollback paths.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Remove stale flags, compatibility shims, dead branches, experimental paths, and obsolete configuration after their exit criteria are met.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Pin and verify build and runtime dependencies sufficiently to prevent unexpected substitution.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Assess dependency API surface, transitive graph, maintenance health, license, provenance, security history, performance, and exit cost before adoption.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Wrap vendor or unstable dependencies only where the wrapper provides a real boundary, not ceremonial indirection.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Treat generated code, models, schemas, clients, migrations, and assets as reproducible outputs with a trusted generator, version, review path, and diff policy.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Do not edit generated output manually unless the process explicitly preserves and verifies such changes.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Ensure dependency upgrades, generator upgrades, and configuration changes receive behavior, compatibility, security, and performance testing.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Remove unused dependencies and capabilities to reduce attack surface and maintenance cost.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Provide a replacement or migration plan for critical unsupported, proprietary, or single-maintainer dependencies.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code

controls.statement: Require every material change to explain intent, scope, risk, alternatives, testing, deployment, rollback, data impact, and observability impact.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Use reviewers with relevant domain, security, privacy, accessibility, data, or operational expertise for high-impact changes.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Review changed behavior in context of callers, consumers, data flows, concurrency, failure paths, and deployment order, not only the diff.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Use automated checks to remove mechanical review burden while never substituting automation for judgment on semantics and risk.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Keep review size and latency within limits that preserve attention; split work by coherent behavior, not arbitrary line count.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Record dissent and unresolved design questions for consequential changes.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Treat technical debt as a specific future cost or risk with evidence, owner, affected outcomes, and trigger for repayment.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Do not label missing requirements, security defects, or production failures as harmless technical debt.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Refactor behind characterization tests or stronger specifications when current behavior is poorly understood.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Separate behavior-preserving refactoring from behavior changes where it improves review and rollback.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Delete dead code and obsolete compatibility paths after confirming no runtime, data, customer, or external dependency remains.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Measure maintainability using defect patterns, change lead time, review difficulty, dependency structure, cognitive load, recovery cost, and ownership—not one complexity metric alone.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Turn escaped defects into regression tests and systemic prevention when practical.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Schedule maintenance before support deadlines, degradation, or concentration of knowledge creates an emergency.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Ensure code ownership and documentation survive staff changes and do not depend on one person.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist
Review, change safety, technical debt, and maintainability

controls.statement: Do not release critical behavior whose invariants, authorization, failure modes, or data effects cannot be explained and tested.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Do not release with known undefined, implementation-dependent, race-prone, overflow-prone, or precision-losing behavior in a critical path.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Do not release when an error, timeout, retry, cancellation, or restart can cause silent corruption, duplicate irreversible effects, or false success.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Do not release unbounded work or allocation reachable from untrusted input when it can exhaust shared resources.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Do not release code that logs reusable secrets, session material, payment credentials, or prohibited personal data.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Do not release a critical dependency, generated artifact, or build output whose source and version cannot be traced and reproduced.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Do not release high-impact code that was self-approved without the required independent review.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Do not release a material refactor without evidence that required behavior and compatibility were preserved.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Do not waive failing tests, static findings, warnings, or code-review concerns without a documented technical disposition and owner.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Do not claim high code quality solely from coverage percentage, linter cleanliness, low complexity, style conformance, or absence of known defects.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist

controls.statement: Define the externally observable behavior, quality attributes, constraints, and failure tolerances before treating implementation as complete.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Correctness, and Maintainability

controls.statement: Trace code to product requirements, architecture decisions, risks, interfaces, data contracts, and tests.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Correctness, and Maintainability

controls.statement: Identify safety-, security-, privacy-, accessibility-, financial-, integrity-, and availability-critical code explicitly.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Correctness, and Maintainability

controls.statement: Assign ownership for each maintained component, package, service, shared library, generated artifact, and operational script.
heading_trail: Universal Code Quality, Correctness, and Maintainability

controls.statement: Document supported runtimes, platforms, protocols, data versions, clients, and compatibility windows.
